AttackAim.ForDirection(AttackDirection.Down) : AttackAim.ForCell(target.Anchor.Value), default, null, null); var before = new CoreIntegrationSnapshot(battle.Buffers); var preview = CombatCommandCalculator.Preview(input, Array.Empty<IMovementTileRule>()); Assert.That(preview.CanAttack, Is.True); var projected = preview.Targets.ToArray().Single(t => t.TargetId == battle.Actor.EntityId); Assert.That(projected.Contacts.Single().OriginalTargetId, Is.EqualTo(target.EntityId)); Assert.That(projected.TargetOccupiedCells.ToArray(), Is.EqualTo(battle.Actor.OccupiedCells)); before.AssertUnchanged(battle.Buffers); if (stale) input = input.WithWorld(input.State.With(traitTurn: new TraitTurnFacts(9, 0)), input.Characters, input.Main, input.SoulCounts, input.Souls, input.EnvironmentBindings); var transition = CombatCommandCalculator.Calculate(input, Array.Empty<IMovementTileRule>()); Assert.That(transition.Accepted, Is.True, transition.Reason); var proposed = transition.Attack.Value; Assert.That(proposed.TraitActivations.ToArray().Count(t => t.Interception != null), Is.EqualTo(1)); Assert.That(proposed.Hits.ToArray().Single(h => h.TargetId == battle.Actor.EntityId).TargetId, Is.EqualTo(battle.Actor.EntityId)); if (stale) { Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => battle.Buffers.BattleWriteSink.Apply(transition)); before.AssertUnchanged(battle.Buffers); return; } battle.Buffers.BattleWriteSink.Apply(transition); Assert.That(battle.Buffers.CombatResultReadSink.TryGetLatest(out var published), Is.True); Assert.That(published.Accepted, Is.True, published.Reason); Assert.That(published.Events.OfType<CombatCharacterEvent>().Any(e => e.Kind == CombatEventKind.Moved || e.Kind == CombatEventKind.Relocated), Is.False); Assert.That(battle.Actor.Anchor, Is.EqualTo(input.Characters.Single(c => c.EntityId == battle.Actor.EntityId).Anchor)); Assert.That(battle.Character(target.CharacterKey).Anchor, Is.EqualTo(target.Anchor)); Assert.That(battle.Character(target.CharacterKey).Health.CurrentHealth, Is.EqualTo(1)); Assert.That(published.ActionCost.Spent, Is.EqualTo(transition.ActionCost.Spent)); var attack = published.Events.OfType<CombatAttackEvent>().Single(); var reaction = attack.Attack.TraitActivations.ToArray().Single(t => t.Interception != null); Assert.That(reaction, Is.SameAs(published.Attack.Value.TraitActivations.ToArray().Single(t => t.Interception != null))); Assert.That(reaction.Interception.ProtectedId, Is.EqualTo(target.EntityId)); Assert.That(reaction.Interception.ActualRecipientId, Is.EqualTo(battle.Actor.EntityId)); Assert.That(reaction.ResultOrigin.CreditedCharacterId, Is.EqualTo(enemy.EntityId)); Assert.That(reaction.ResultOrigin.PhysicalCell, Is.EqualTo(enemy.Anchor)); int start = published.Events.ToList().IndexOf(attack); int consumed = published.Events.ToList().FindIndex(e => e is CombatTraitStateEvent t && t.Final.EntityId == battle.Actor.EntityId); Assert.That(start, Is.LessThan(consumed)); Assert.That(published.Events.OfType<CombatEffectsEvent>().SelectMany(e => e.Traits).Any(t => t.Interception != null), Is.False); var children = published.Events.OfType<CombatEffectsEvent>().SelectMany(e => e.Traits).Where(t => t.ChildAttack != null).ToArray(); Assert.That(children.Length, Is.EqualTo(child ? 1 : 0)); if (child) { Assert.That(children[0].ChildAttack.Reactions.Count, Is.EqualTo(1)); Assert.That(children[0].ChildAttack.Hits.Single().TargetHealthBefore, Is.EqualTo(proposed.Hits.ToArray().Single(h => h.TargetId == battle.Actor.EntityId).TargetHealthAfter)); Assert.That(children[0].ChildAttack.Hits.Single().TargetHealthAfter, Is.EqualTo(battle.Actor.Health.CurrentHealth)); } else Assert.That(proposed.Hits.ToArray().Single(h => h.TargetId == battle.Actor.EntityId).TargetHealthAfter, Is.EqualTo(battle.Actor.Health.CurrentHealth)); var once = new CoreIntegrationSnapshot(battle.Buffers); for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { Assert.That(battle.Buffers.CombatResultReadSink.TryGetLatest(out var reread), Is.True); Assert.That(reread, Is.SameAs(published)); Assert.That(battle.Core.CombatCommands.ProcessNextCommand(), Is.False); } Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => battle.Buffers.BattleWriteSink.Apply(transition)); once.AssertUnchanged(battle.Buffers); }
